description: This source file implements the PruneNoOps function, which traverses and modifies an abstract syntax tree (AST) to remove no-op nodes such as empty declarations and literal statements, within the ANGLE project shader compiler.

classes.name: PruneNoOpsTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify and remove no-op nodes such as empty declarations and literal statements.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies the pruning traversal to the AST root.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits declaration nodes to prune empty or invalid declarations.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Visits block nodes to remove no-op statements.

methods.name: visitLoop
methods.description: Visits loop nodes to remove no-op expressions or initializations.
